triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER approval_lines_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.order_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fulfillment_private.guard_lines()
CREATE TRIGGER approval_order_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fulfillment_private.guard_order()
CREATE TRIGGER cash_allocation_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_private.guard_cash_allocation()
CREATE TRIGGER pilot_admission_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF driver_id ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION pilot_private.guard_order()
CREATE TRIGGER pilot_admission_record AFTER INSERT ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION pilot_private.record_admission()
CREATE TRIGGER return_order_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF status, store_id, driver_id, customer_id ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION return_private.guard_case_order()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_orders AFTER UPDATE ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_changes('id', 'driver_id', 'cash_settled_at')
CREATE TRIGGER trg_order_dispatch AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_dispatch()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_order_events AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION log_order_event()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_orders_loyalty BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_loyalty()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_orders_wallet_return BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_wallet_return()

constraints.name: order_items_order_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: cash_allocation_consistent
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((cash_allocation_version IS NULL) AND (cash_platform_share IS NULL) AND (cash_driver_delivery_share IS NULL) AND (cash_allocation_reference IS NULL)) OR ((cash_allocation_version = 1) AND (cash_platform_share IS NOT NULL) AND (cash_driver_delivery_share IS NOT NULL) AND (cash_allocation_reference IS NOT NULL) AND (cash_platform_share >= (0)::numeric) AND (cash_driver_delivery_share >= (0)::numeric) AND ((cash_platform_share + cash_driver_delivery_share) = delivery_fee))))

constraints.name: orders_group_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES group_orders(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
